question: Teal is in (round-014 c, now in theme.css). Now icons and spacing, as one feel per variant: which glyphs, stroke and treatment, and how much room? Colors and layout are the same in all three. Icons now also sit on badges, the view switch and Submit so there is more to judge.

variants.label: Hairline, roomy
variants.changes: Today's glyphs (Columns, Library, Palette, History) at a thin 1.25 stroke and 20px. Roomy: 64px header, 32px page padding, taller table rows, a wider answer bar.

variants.label: Bold, compact
variants.changes: A different set (split square, bookmark, swatch book, clock, arrows, star moon) at a heavy 2.25 stroke and 16px. Compact: 48px header, 12px padding, tight rows, a slim bar. Most on screen at once.

variants.label: Icon tiles, medium
variants.changes: Another set (gallery, library, brush, scroll, circled arrows, send) at 1.75 stroke. Page icons sit in small teal tiles. Medium spacing, close to today.
